_about: Hand-built AI Story Briefs over the fictional sample articles in articles.json, for Section 5 tests. Each brief lists its sources in citation order (c1, c2, ...); claims cite those ids. 'story' creates a Story with one StoryEvent per source.

model_launch.headline: Lumen-4: vendor reports 92.1% on its own benchmark; independent test finds 84.3% on new problems
model_launch.summary: Lumen Labs released Lumen-4 and says it scores 92.1% on the MathBench-Pro benchmark in its own tests [c1]. The Open Evaluation Collective's independent benchmark found Lumen-4 scored 84.3% on 1,200 held-out problems written after its training cutoff (preprint, not peer reviewed) [c3]. A Circuit Ledger article first misstated the independent score and was corrected [c5].
model_launch.why_it_matters: Developers and schools weighing Lumen-4 now have an independent evaluation to compare with the vendor's figures [c3].

sections.title: What happened?
sections.body: Lumen Labs released Lumen-4 through its paid API [c1][c2].

sections.title: What evidence exists?
sections.body: An independent evaluation on held-out problems found 84.3% [c3].

claims.text: Lumen Labs says Lumen-4 scores 92.1% on MathBench-Pro in the company's own testing.
The Open Evaluation Collective's independent benchmark found Lumen-4 scored 84.3% on a held-out set of 1,200 math problems written after its training cutoff.
The Open Evaluation Collective found 6.2% of MathBench-Pro problems appear verbatim in public web data predating Lumen-4's training cutoff.
Lumen-4 is available only through Lumen Labs' paid API, and its weights are not public.
Lumen-4 outperforms every competing model on multi-step math problems.

uncertainty: The independent evaluation is a preprint and has not been peer reviewed [c3].
watch_next: Replication of the independent results by a second group [c3].

tutor_launch.headline: Lumen Labs launches Lumen Tutor, citing pilot data it has not released
tutor_launch.summary: Lumen Labs launched Lumen Tutor, a math tutoring product built on Lumen-4, at $14 per student per year [c1].
tutor_launch.why_it_matters: Districts deciding whether to buy the tool have only the vendor's claims so far [c1].

claims.text: Lumen Tutor costs $14 per student per year for districts.
Lumen Labs said Lumen Tutor helps students master math faster, citing internal pilots with 180 students, but did not release data from those pilots.

learning_study.headline: AI practice assistant study: students finished faster, but transfer gains were not significant
learning_study.summary: Halbrook University said its StepWise AI practice assistant helped ninth graders learn algebra 30% faster [c1]. The underlying preprint found students completed exercise sets 31% faster, but the difference on a transfer test of unfamiliar problems was not statistically significant [c2][c3].
learning_study.why_it_matters: Schools need to know whether a tool speeds up practice or improves understanding; these are different measures of learning [c3].

sections.title: What does the evidence show?
sections.body: Students finished practice sets faster; the transfer difference was not significant [c2].

claims.text: Students using StepWise completed exercise sets in a median of 22 minutes versus 32 minutes for the comparison group.
On the transfer test, StepWise students scored 61.4% versus 59.6%, a difference that was not statistically significant.
The study randomly assigned 14 ninth-grade algebra classrooms with 212 students in one Calder school district for eight weeks.
Halbrook University's “30% faster” claim refers to how quickly students finished practice sets.
StepWise helped ninth graders learn algebra 30% faster.
Opinion (The Classroom Dispatch): A learning scientist argues the press release conflated speed with learning.

uncertainty: The study is a preprint and has not been peer reviewed [c2].
Two authors hold equity in the company that licenses StepWise [c2].

positions.position: Halbrook University: students learned algebra 30% faster.
The preprint: faster completion, no significant transfer difference.

watch_next: Peer-reviewed publication and a longer study with a larger transfer test [c3].

policy.headline: Calder adopts AI literacy requirement for grades 6-12 with phased rollout through 2029
policy.summary: The Calder State Board of Education voted 7-2 to require AI literacy instruction in grades 6-12, starting with a 40-district pilot in 2027-28 [c1]. High school requirements begin in fall 2028 and middle school requirements in fall 2029 [c1][c2].
policy.why_it_matters: Teachers, districts, and families face a multi-year rollout whose funding and assessment are not settled [c2].

claims.text: The requirement takes effect statewide in fall 2028 for grades 9-12 and in fall 2029 for grades 6-8.
The Board approved $14 million for teacher training in the first year.
The requirement does not apply to private schools.
Superintendents from 23 rural districts asked the Board to delay the requirement by one year.
The legislature will fund teacher training after the first year.

uncertainty: The Board has not decided whether or how AI literacy will be assessed [c1].
Funding for later years depends on appropriations by the state legislature [c1].
watch_next: Draft standards due for public comment by March 2027 [c1].

semiconductor.headline: Corvane's Calder Valley fab reached 11,500 wafers a month, behind its 15,000 interim target
semiconductor.summary: Corvane Semiconductor announced an $8.2 billion expansion projecting 40,000 wafer starts per month by late 2027 [c1]. Fab 3 exited the fiscal third quarter at 11,500 wafer starts per month, short of the 15,000 interim target [c2].
semiconductor.why_it_matters: Suppliers, customers, and workers depend on whether the ramp keeps pace with its projections [c3].

claims.text: Corvane projects 40,000 wafer starts per month of 3nm-class capacity at Calder Valley Fab 3 by late 2027.
Fab 3 exited Corvane's fiscal third quarter at 11,500 wafer starts per month, short of the 15,000 interim target.
Orrin Lithography said lead times for its newest lithography systems have stretched to about 18 months.
Pinecrest Mobile signed a multi-year agreement to source 3nm-class wafers from Corvane's Calder Valley expansion.
Three Calder community colleges will launch 16-week cleanroom technician certificate programs.

uncertainty: Corvane has not disclosed when it placed its tool orders [c4].
watch_next: Reported output against projections each quarter [c2].

backtest.headline: Northbridge's AI portfolio agents beat a 60/40 portfolio in a backtest, not in live trading
backtest.summary: Northbridge Bank researchers reported that AI portfolio agents returned 7.9% a year versus 6.6% for a 60/40 benchmark in a 2005-2024 backtest [c1][c2]. The agents have no live track record and will enter a 12-month paper-trading pilot [c3].
backtest.why_it_matters: A backtest shows how a strategy would have done on past data; it is not a live track record [c2].

claims.text: In a backtest covering 2005 through 2024, the agents' simulated portfolio returned 7.9% a year versus 6.6% for the 60/40 benchmark.
The authors caution that the result is in-sample and is not proof of future outperformance.
Northbridge said the agents will run in a 12-month paper-trading pilot with no client money.
Northbridge said the agents are not used for client portfolios.

uncertainty: The bank has not said whether it plans to test the agents with real money [c2].
watch_next: Results of the paper-trading pilot, which would be simulated results [c3].

earnings.headline: Corvane reports fiscal Q3 revenue of $3.42 billion, above its guidance range
earnings.summary: Corvane Semiconductor reported fiscal third-quarter revenue of $3.42 billion, up 18% from a year earlier and above its guidance range of $3.25 billion to $3.40 billion [c1][c2].
earnings.why_it_matters: Results above the company's own guidance say little on their own; comparisons with the prior year matter more [c2].

claims.text: Corvane's fiscal third-quarter revenue was $3.42 billion, compared with $2.90 billion a year earlier.
Diluted earnings per share were $1.12, compared with $0.91 a year earlier.
Corvane guided fourth-quarter revenue of $3.60 billion to $3.80 billion.

funding.headline: Tarnwell Compute raises $220 million Series D led by Orbit Growth Partners
funding.summary: AI chip designer Tarnwell Compute raised $220 million in a Series D round led by Orbit Growth Partners [c1].
funding.why_it_matters: Funding announcements show where investors are active; they are not verdicts on companies [c1].

claims.text: Tarnwell Compute raised $220 million in a Series D round led by Orbit Growth Partners.

enforcement.headline: Regulator fines adviser $310,000 over AI claims; broker-dealer authority proposes agent supervision rules
enforcement.summary: The Markets Integrity Commission settled charges that Brightvane Advisors marketed AI agents it did not use [c1][c2]. Separately, the Broker-Dealer Standards Authority proposed supervision expectations for AI agents at member firms [c3].
enforcement.why_it_matters: Marketing claims about AI are held to the same accuracy rules as other claims [c2].

claims.text: Brightvane Advisors agreed to a $310,000 civil penalty without admitting or denying the findings.
The BDSA proposed that member firms inventory AI agents, set authority limits, and keep audit trails for three years; comments are due in 60 days.
